output.answer_markdown: PulteGroup's net cash used in financing activities fell from $733.6 million in 2019 to $295.6 million in 2020 [1]. In 2020 the main uses were share repurchases, debt repayments and dividends: $170.7 million to repurchase 4.5 million shares, $65.3 million of debt repayments, and $130.2 million of cash dividends [2]. In 2019 the main uses were the same three categories: $274.3 million to repurchase 8.4 million shares, $310.0 million of debt repayments, and $122.4 million of cash dividends [3].

provenance.quote: Net cash used in financing activities was $295.6 million in 2020 compared with $733.6 million during 2019.
